Name: Auto Perfect Fishing
Author: MD0uroa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Auto Perfect Fishing[/b] is a quality-of-life mod designed to streamline the fishing experience in Stardew Valley. It automates the fishing minigame, allowing you to secure a "Perfect" catch every time without the need for manual tracking or clicking, and automatically hooks fish the moment they bite. Perfect for players who want to focus on other aspects of the game or those who find the fishing mechanic challenging.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][b]Install SMAPI[/b]: Ensure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] installed.[/*]
[*][b]Download the Mod[/b]: Download the
[code].zip[/code]file from the Files tab.[/*]
[*][b]Extract[/b]: Extract the downloaded
[code].zip[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]directory.[/*]
[*][b]Run[/b]: Launch the game using the SMAPI shortcut.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[*][b]Auto Perfect:[/b] Automatically wins the fishing minigame. The green bar locks onto the fish's position, ensuring a "Perfect" quality catch every time.[/*]
[*][b]Auto Hook:[/b] Instantly triggers the reel-in function the moment a fish bites (detects the exclamation mark). No need to press 'C' or click the mouse.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Treasure Hunter (v1.1.0+):[/b] Automatically detects treasure chests. The mod will hold the fish in place, wait for the chest to appear, loot it, and then finish the main catch.[/*]
[*][b]Anti-Spam Trigger:[/b] Built-in safety logic prevents multiple reel-in attempts when catching trash or seaweed, avoiding potential bugs and double-loot errors.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]SMAPI[/b] (v4.0.0 or higher recommended).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Game Version[/b]: Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ (or whichever version you are currently using).[/color]


> 💖 Shout Outs:
* Big thanks to Pathoschild for creating SMAPI and the amazing ModBuildConfig tool.
* Special thanks to Andreas Pardeike for the incredible Harmony library that makes advanced code patching possible.
* Special thanks to the Stardew Valley Modding Community for the extensive documentation and wonderful support


[b] * Note for Android Users:[/b] This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley Android (SMAPI). However, please note that using this mod alongside other fishing-related mods may cause conflicts, especially regarding the Treasure Chest logic. If you encounter any issues with treasure or minigame glitches while using other fishing mods, it is recommended to run this mod as a standalone.
[b]
* Catatan untuk Pengguna Android:[/b] Mod ini kompatibel dengan Stardew Valley Android (SMAPI). Namun, harap diperhatikan bahwa menggunakan mod ini bersamaan dengan mod memancing lainnya mungkin akan menyebabkan konflik, terutama pada bagian logika [i]Treasure Chest[/i]. Jika kamu mengalami kendala seperti bug pada peti harta karun atau [i]glitch[/i] minigame saat menggunakan mod mancing lain, disarankan untuk menjalankan mod ini secara terpisah (tanpa mod mancing lain).
